scope: Exploratory proportional allocation for positive score-support passives and previously documented numeric boards. Production untouched.

formula.weight: w_i = p_i * effectiveValue_i * duration_i * floor(200 / interval_i), using base Active inputs.
formula.joint: S = existing normalized 200-second BPraw - Araw, using board-adjusted timing/probability and additive support.
formula.allocation: Passive = ceil0.1(S * PW/(PW+BW)); Board = ceil0.1(S * BW/(PW+BW)).
formula.interpretation: Divide the modeled total increment by nominal standalone buff weights. This is an attribution hypothesis, not evidence the game literally implements these intermediate weights.
